Department of Housing and Urban Developm.title: HUD 2024 Housing Choice Voucher renewal eligibility by state and territory
Department of Housing and Urban Developm.basis: HUD's authority-level award list reports $26.625444529B of 2024 prorated Housing Choice Voucher renewal eligibility after offsets across 2,075 Public Housing Authorities. These 55 state and territory totals reconcile exactly to the published authority rows. The list is a source-native eligibility view within HUD's broader $30B renewal-funding announcement, not an additive child of Treasury's $33.976B FY2024 Tenant Based Rental Assistance cash outlay.
